title: Greedy numeration systems and regularity
notes: Theory of Computing Systems 31 (1998), 111-133. If a positional system has a dominant root beta>1 and the greedy language is regular, then beta is Parry. This classifies greedy representation languages, not the Baranwal unread-tail residual. It does not decide whether the live residual of a fixed Gamma-addition process is finite.
